root_cause: Committed AI Modelwijzer regression tests were not wired into a canonical CI workflow.
Fail-closed static English cache completeness was not validated in Required test before merge, allowing a deterministic Netlify build failure to surface only during production promotion.
prevention: Wire every committed regression test into a canonical workflow.
Validate static English cache pre-merge with STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
Repair missing cache entries in the same candidate lineage before merge.
Keep transport/auth failures separate from build-content failures.

evidence.observed_failure: Current main repeatedly failed Netlify production build after protected merge while three newly committed AI Modelwijzer regression tests were reported as unwired by delivery-test-coverage-guard.
evidence.affected_runtime: Production Source Snapshot / exact-source Netlify production build
evidence.deterministic_premerge_reproduction: Required test now validates static English cache under production fail-closed flags before merge.
